scientific_integrity: Twenty-two feasible active faces are classified analytically; the finite rational projector table and witness are included with reproducible standard-library code. The result is not externally certified.
scientific_limitations: Only three ground elements, all eight set-function coordinates, unweighted Euclidean least squares, no monotonicity or normalization. Independent bibliographic verification has not been performed; an equivalent result under alternate terminology may exist.
title: The sharp sup-norm sensitivity of three-variable submodular regression
